flush_accumulation_at: every 1000 samples and epoch end, same for all arms
schedule: linear warmup then cosine; planned updates=30*ceil(1000/32)=960
logit_adjustment: add log(p/(1-p)) to BCE logits, tau=1; p=(train positives+1)/(train non-uncertain+2); binary extension, train-only priors
auxiliary_head_input: mean projected visual tokens; BCE gradients reach projector; F0 standalone native-feature timing head is not used for F1 training
matching: reset seed immediately before shared bridge initialization; same model seed, deterministic training order and schedules for A2/A3/A4
dev_checks: first 8 P4 MIMIC val + first 8 P4 Indiana, every 1000 samples
collapse: two consecutive checks: unique<4/16 OR cap256>=12/16; stop that arm
interventions: first50 MIMIC+first50 Indiana; A4 scores all0 and seeded shuffle across100, no ground truth evidence
